item.description: Tributes have been paid to Lord Zetland, who died peacefully at home in North Yorkshire at the weekend, aged 88. PETER BARRON looks back at his colourful life.

item.title: Watch: Sabalenka punished by umpire for disruptive grunting
item.description: World No 1 Aryna Sabalenka cruised into her fourth successive Australian Open final despite losing a penalty point when the umpire deemed her grunt to be off-putting.

item.title: Rybakina battles into Australian Open final against Sabalenka
item.description: Elena Rybakina battled past Jessica Pegula into the Australian Open final on Thursday with the fifth seed setting up a repeat of her 2023 title match against Aryna Sabalenka.Moscow-born Rybakina, who defeated second seed Iga Swiatek in the quarter-finals, is trying to get back on the Grand Slam title board for the first time in three-and-a-half years after winning Wimbledon in 2022.

item.title: Umpire call fired up Sabalenka in politically charged Melbourne clash
item.description: Belarusian Aryna Sabalenka said that an umpire call against her for grunting helped fire her to victory over Ukraine's Elina Svitolina on Thursday in a politically charged Australian Open semi-final."I was not happy with the call, and it really helped me to get that game."

item.title: Aryna Sabalenka coasts past Elina Svitolina to set up final with Elena Rybakina
item.description: Sabalenka defeated Elina Svitolina while Rybakina battled past Jessica Pegula.

item.title: No handshake as Sabalenka sets up repeat of 2023 Melbourne final
item.description: Belarusian world number one Aryna Sabalenka crushed Ukraine's Elina Svitolina in a politically charged Australian Open semi-final on Thursday and faces Elena Rybakina for a third Melbourne title.The hard-hitting 27-year-old is into her fourth Australian Open final in a row and is yet to drop a set in 2026.
